# Agent Entry Point

This repository keeps all AI workflow source files under `.github`.

Primary agent:

- `.github/agents/dev-workflow.agent.md`

Canonical short project context:

- `.github/ai-project-context.md`

Skills:

- `.github/skills/*/SKILL.md`

Compatibility files outside `.github` are symlinks or generated mirrors only.
Do not add new source-of-truth AI workflow content outside `.github`.
